headline: As of 2026-10-27: 33,118,296 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+11.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 33,118,296 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+11.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (4,911,555), California (3,382,645), Florida (3,186,591).
